svg.title: US feature development workflow with approval gates
svg.desc: A flowchart showing the complete feature development lifecycle from branch kickoff through retro, with three critical approval gates in the planning phase.

g.text: /implement US-001 T-NNN (one task at a time)
Failing tests, write code, run suite (per task)
Stop hook re-runs affected tests after each session
/security-review US-001 → OWASP/STRIDE vs threat model (no Blockers)
git push -u origin feature/US-001, open PR (branch protection runs)
